name: Bitbox 2.0
source: bitbox-mk2-2.0-user-manual-2023-03-01-clean.pdf p.7 (Front Panel Overview, manual pp.10-11) and p.41 (EXT Ports figure)
notes: Manual: MIDI in (TRS, type A/B), clock in, 2 audio ins, 20 CV inputs, 4 audio outs. The 5x4 CV grid is unlabelled on the panel: the first four columns trigger the 16 pads (named here TRIG 1-16, row by row from top-left); the 4th column doubles as EXT 5-8 (top to bottom) and the 5th (rightmost) column is EXT 1-4 (top to bottom) for modulation. IN1/IN2 are a stereo record pair and also usable as precise CV (1V/oct). Outputs FX1/FX2/OUT1/OUT2 are configurable as mono or stereo pairs.
